data.evidence_sentence: To be eligible for an RTP Stipend, RTP Fees Offset, RTP Allowance or DUPRS an applicant must be a domestic or international student enrolled in a graduate research course of study at Deakin University.
data.notes: Page covers several awards (RTP Stipend, RTP Fees Offset, RTP Allowance, DUPRS) under one name; the text does not specify which is named. No application deadline stated. Relocation allowance and OSHC are benefits, not funding types. Fees offset is a partial tuition offset, not full tuition. Text is duplicated on the page. Field of study not stated. Page mentions graduate research courses only; master level inferred from 'Research masters degree' duration.
